entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'm calling because I need to return a pair of cycling shoes I bought a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order from October 15th for the Pro-Lace cycling shoes. So I can best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?

They just don't fit right. I've tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but no matter what I do, after any ride longer than an hour, I get terrible blisters on my heels. I'd like to process a refund.

I'm sorry to hear they're causing you discomfort. Getting blisters is definitely no fun. Let me just check our return policy for you... Okay, it looks like you're well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for you.

That's great news, thank you. I appreciate you making that easy. Since I did have to go through the trouble and the discomfort, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? I'd still like to try a different model.

I understand why you're asking. While I can't provide a discount code on top of the full refund, I'm happy to email you the pre-paid return shipping label right now. Once we receive the shoes, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Alright, that's fair. I thought it was worth a shot. Sending the label now would be perfect.
Of course. I've just sent that email to the address on file. Please let me know if there is anything else I can help you with today.
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
